sheets.name: run_1
sheets.action: running (his move loop): scuttling forward low, the head bobbing, the spines and the tail swaying, the LEGS CHANGING OVER as written for each frame
sheets.weapons: THE MOUTH is the only part that changes shape: where the pale figure's mouth stretches out into a long CRIMSON TUBE (forward, at the ground, or straight up in R), draw the fleshy crimson-magenta tube there, 2-4 squares thick, a ring of small fangs at its open end, as long as the pale figure has it; elsewhere the round fanged mouth of image 1. The bony head with its eyes and spines stays image 1's in every frame; the blue shell, the teal belly, the little bony fore-claws and the short bony tail stay on him. Only him: no acid, no spit, no ooze, no shells, no glow; the eyes' orange stays inside the eyes.
sheets.legs: Frame 1: SUPPORT ON THE NEAR LEG: the NEAR leg (the lighter one) straight down under his hips, his big blue clawed foot flat on the ground line; the FAR leg (the darker one) bent and kicked back behind him, its foot off the ground. The two legs TAKE TURNS: in frames 1-4 the NEAR leg (the lighter one) carries him and the FAR leg comes forward, in frames 5-8 the FAR leg (the darker one) carries him and the NEAR leg comes forward - frames 1 and 5 must show a different leg planted. Draw the legs AS WRITTEN for each frame, not the pale figure's (the old 1x legs are too small to read; runs drawn after them kept the same legs in all 8 frames: 「走路没有换腿」). The body, the head, the spines and the tail follow the pale figure. The little bony fore-claws under his jaw and the tail are NOT legs: his two stubby legs with the big clawed feet carry him.

Only him: no acid, no spit, no ooze, no shells, no glow; the eyes' orange stays inside the eyes.
